scripts.dev: npm run sandbox:up && concurrently -n client,api,ws,worker,studio -c cyan,magenta,green,blue,yellow "npm:dev --workspace=client" "npm:dev --workspace=@mockmatch/api" "npm:dev:ws --workspace=@mockmatch/api" "npm:dev:worker --workspace=@mockmatch/api" "npm:db:studio --workspace=@mockmatch/api"
scripts.sandbox:install-gvisor: docker compose -f infra/sandbox/docker-compose.gvisor.yml run --rm runsc-installer && docker info
scripts.sandbox:smoke: docker inspect -f "status={{.State.Status}} runtime={{.HostConfig.Runtime}} network={{.HostConfig.NetworkMode}} readonly={{.HostConfig.ReadonlyRootfs}}" mockmatch-sandbox && docker exec mockmatch-sandbox uname -a && docker exec mockmatch-sandbox node -v && docker exec mockmatch-sandbox python3 --version && docker exec -u coder mockmatch-sandbox python3 -c "import socket; s=socket.socket(); s.settimeout(2); s.connect(('1.1.1.1',80))" 2>nul || echo OK: no-network && docker exec mockmatch-sandbox sh -c "echo x>/etc/pwned" 2>nul || echo OK: ro-rootfs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@mockmatch/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=client
scripts.fallow: fallow dead-code && fallow dupes && fallow health --report-only
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run fallow:audit
